title: haven: does mimi-bot still exist on the -07 hub? If so, run an echo exchange from mimid
description: Jason's IETF 126 post on Zulip #mimi (2026-07-18) announced mimi-bot at mimi://havenmessenger.com/u/mimi-bot: fetch its KeyPackage via keyMaterial, Add it, send the Welcome, and it echoes application messages. That was on protocol-06. Its domain is havenmessenger.com, not mimi.havenmessenger.com, and the edd3ba1 seed doesn't mention it. Ask Jason whether it runs on the -07 hub; if it does, add an echo round trip to mimid-chat or the probe (tools/interop/haven/probe).
